Editor.problem: Earlier point 4 is only partly fixed. seconds_to_drain now comes from q-$run.txt, and t_down/t_up are now written to runs.txt, so the old 10 s floor is gone. Two parts are still missing. (a) watch_figures takes the first read after t_up where size <= pre_peak, with no check that it stays there. Until t_load+50 s the load is still arriving, and with sending_queue batching the queue size rises and falls as batches form and flush. One low read can end the drain early, and that would make the migrated and sized numbers look better than they are. (b) No drain_complete measurement exists. The post-load loop still treats queue_size=0 with sent unchanged as done, never checks that sent = accepted − enqueue_failed, and reads gw-end even when it gives up at the 60 s DRAIN_MAX. If a slow drain hits that limit, gateway_spans_sent will be too low and spans_lost too high, with no sign in the output.
Editor.fix: In watch_figures, set dr only when the read and the next 2 reads (3 in a row) are all at or below pp. In outage_run, record drain_complete=yes only when sent has stopped moving AND sent equals accepted minus enqueue_failed (read from gw-$1-now.txt). Otherwise record no. Print `HERO_MEASURE: drain_complete[$run]=yes|no`, add it to results.txt and the summary, and add it to the contract (kind 'state', op present, min_entities 6). In fix.sh, make 'fixed' require drain_complete=yes in sized-1 and sized-2.
